funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; postdoctoral level for higher tier; open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible support for research travel and research time in British art, visual culture and architecture.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; must have a confirmed publisher and a publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Support for publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles in British art, visual culture and architecture.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Flexible support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; publication can be for forthcoming or past exhibition.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to exhibitions showcasing new research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research through live, online or hybrid events in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking conservation research on items in public or charitable ownership.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support vital conservation research on British art items from organisational collections.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking digitisation of collections related to British art.
opportunities.summary: Support for making collections freely available online through digitisation projects.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals enrolled in or starting a master's or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for students to begin or continue postgraduate study in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country researching eighteenth- or nineteenth‑century works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Support for research trips to examine historic works on paper such as prints, drawings and watercolours.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 for one year (or split over two years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a master's degree at a UK institution, start date between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree that will bring new perspectives to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a doctorate at a UK institution, start date between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support doctoral research that expands understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral level researchers or those with equivalent experience.
opportunities.summary: Funding to undertake an in‑depth research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board, accommodation and honorarium for a three‑month stay

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome to conduct research on British‑Italian cultural exchange.
